identity.retryPolicy: Transport failures (timeout (180s), network error, HTTP 408/409/429/5xx, unreadable API response with 5xx, incomplete or missing output) are retried up to 4 attempts per turn with exponential backoff honoring Retry-After and provider reset headers. Live calls use a 5-second minimum pace, increasing automatically to stay under 80% of a reported token/minute limit, and live episodes cool down by 30 seconds; every attempt and sanitized rate-limit header is recorded. Exhausted HTTP 429 retries interrupt the batch as infrastructure rather than counting as model failure. Invalid model output (unparseable JSON, schema violation, refusal) is not retried or repaired: it is recorded as an invalid response and terminates the episode as unsolved. A valid direction that is visibly blocked is not retried or repaired: it is executed as a blocked move, counts as a wall hit, consumes the turn, and the episode continues.

aiTransport.policy: Provider requests use the shared Vercel AI SDK transport with structured output. SDK retries are disabled; Echo Maze owns every retry, pacing delay, and attempt record.

identity.coordinateSystem: Walker-relative coordinates start at (0,0). A successful move right changes x by +1, left by -1, up by +1, down by -1. A blocked move changes nothing. The Walker never receives absolute maze rows/columns.
identity.hiddenStatePolicy: The prompt receives only the narrow observation DTO (open/blocked directions, corridor sightlines, per-visible-cell open directions and isExit flag, last action/result) plus the current run's conversation. No full maze, no exit coordinates, no seed, no optimal route, no unseen cells, and no spectator state may enter the prompt.

payload.notes: Start at (0,0). Open: up, left. Up cell (0,1) opens down,left. Left cell (-1,0) opens right,down. Moving up to explore.
At (0,1). Left leads to (-1,1) which only opens right (dead end). Moving down back to (0,0) to take the other branch towards (-1,0).
Back at (0,0). Up leads to dead end at (-1,1). Now heading left to (-1,0), which opens down.
At (-1,0). Open: right (back to 0,0), down (corridor leading down 3 steps to (-1,-3) which opens right). Moving down.
At (-1,-1). Open: up, down. Down corridor continues 2 more steps to (-1,-3) where it opens right. Moving down.
At (-1,-2). Open: up, down. Next step down is (-1,-3) which turns right. Moving down.
At (-1,-3). Open: up (back), right (to (0,-3) which opens up,left). Moving right.
At (0,-3). Open: up, left. Up sightline distance 2: (0,-2) opens up/down, (0,-1) opens right/down. Left is back to (-1,-3). Moving up.
At (0,-2). Open: up, down. Up goes to (0,-1) which opens right,down. Moving up.
At (0,-1). Open: right, down. Right cell (1,-1) opens down,left. Down goes back. Moving right.
At (1,-1). Open: down, left. Left goes back to (0,-1). Down cell (1,-2) opens up,right. Moving down.
At (1,-2). Open: up, right. Up goes back to (1,-1). Right cell (2,-2) opens down,left. Moving right.
At (2,-2). Open: down, left. Left returns to (1,-2). Down cell (2,-3) opens up, right. Moving down.
At (2,-3). Open: up, right. Up returns to (2,-2). Right leads to (3,-3) which opens down,left. Moving right.
At (3,-3). Open: down, left. Left returns to (2,-3). Down sightline has distance 2: (3,-4) opens up/down, (3,-5) opens up/right. Moving down.
At (3,-4). Open: up, down. Down goes to (3,-5) which opens up, right. Moving down.
At (3,-5). Open: up, right. Up is back to (3,-4). Right corridor has (4,-5) opening right,left, and (5,-5) opening up,left. Moving right.
At (4,-5). Open: right, left. Left returns to (3,-5). Right cell (5,-5) opens up, left. Moving right.
At (5,-5). Open: up, left. Left is back to (4,-5). Sightline up shows distance 2: (5,-4) opens up/down, (5,-3) opens down/left. Moving up.
At (5,-4). Open: up, down. Down goes back to (5,-5). Up cell is (5,-3) which opens down, left. Moving up.
At (5,-3). Open: down, left. Left cell is (4,-3) which opens up, right, down. Down goes back to (5,-4). Moving left.
At (4,-3). Open: up, right, down. Right returns to (5,-3). Down cell (4,-4) opens only up (dead end). Up cell (4,-2) opens right, down. Moving up.
At (4,-2). Open: right, down. Down goes back to (4,-3). Right cell (5,-2) opens up, left. Moving right.
At (5,-2). Open: up, left. Left returns to (4,-2). Up sightline shows (5,-1) opens up/down, (5,0) opens right/down. Moving up.
At (5,-1). Open: up, down. Down goes back to (5,-2). Up goes to (5,0) which opens right, down. Moving up.
At (5,0). Open: right, down. Down leads back to (5,-1). Right cell (6,0) opens up, left. Moving right.
At (6,0). Open: up, left. Left returns to (5,0). Up cell (6,1) opens right, down, left. Moving up.

At (6,1). Open: right, down, left. Down returns to (6,0). Right goes to (7,1) which opens down,left. Left goes 5 steps to (1,1) which opens right,down. Let's explore right first or left. Let's check right.
At (7,1). Open: down, left. Down sightline shows (7,0) opens up/down, (7,-1) opens up/left. Let's explore down.
At (7,0). Open: up, down. Down goes to (7,-1) which opens up, left. Moving down.
At (7,-1). Open: up, left. Left is (6,-1) opening right,down. Up goes back to (7,0). Moving left.
At (6,-1). Open: right (back to 7,-1), down (to 6,-2 which opens up,right). Moving down.
At (6,-2). Open: up, right. Right goes to (7,-2) which opens down,left. Up returns to (6,-1). Moving right.
At (7,-2). Open: down, left. Left returns to (6,-2). Down leads to (7,-3) which opens up, left. Moving down.
At (7,-3). Open: up, left. Up returns to (7,-2). Left leads to (6,-3) which opens right, down. Moving left.
At (6,-3). Open: right (back to 7,-3), down (corridor of 3 down to (6,-6) which opens up,right). Moving down.
At (6,-4). Corridor down: (6,-5) opens up/down, (6,-6) opens up/right. Continuing down.
At (6,-5). Open: up, down. Down goes to (6,-6) which opens up, right. Moving down.
At (6,-6). Open: up, right. Up goes back to (6,-5). Right sightline shows (7,-6) opens up,down,left. Moving right.
At (7,-6). Open: up, down, left. Left returns to (6,-6). Up sightline: (7,-5) opens up/down, (7,-4) opens down (dead end). Down sightline: (7,-7) opens up,left. Moving down.
At (7,-7). Open: up, left. Up returns to (7,-6). Left sightline: (6,-7) opens right,left; (5,-7) opens up,right. Moving left.
At (6,-7). Open: right (back to 7,-7), left (to 5,-7 which opens up,right). Moving left.
At (5,-7). Open: up, right. Right returns to (6,-7). Up cell is (5,-6) which opens down, left. Moving up.
At (5,-6). Open: down, left. Down returns to (5,-7). Left sightline: (4,-6) opens right,left; (3,-6) opens right,down. Moving left.
At (4,-6). Open: right, left. Right returns to (5,-6). Left goes to (3,-6) which opens right, down. Moving left.
At (3,-6). Open: right (back to 4,-6), down (to 3,-7 which opens up,right,left). Moving down.
At (3,-7). Open: up, right, left. Up returns to (3,-6). Right is (4,-7) which only opens left (dead end). Left goes 3 steps to (0,-7) which opens up,right. Moving left.
At (2,-7). Open: right, left. Right returns to (3,-7). Left sightline: (1,-7) opens right,left; (0,-7) opens up,right. Continuing left.
At (1,-7). Open: right, left. Left leads to (0,-7) which opens up,right. Moving left.
At (0,-7). Open: up, right. Right returns to (1,-7). Up sightline shows (0,-6) opens down,left. Moving up.
At (0,-6). Open: down, left. Down returns to (0,-7). Left leads to (-1,-6) which opens up,right,down. Moving left.
At (-1,-6). Open: up, right, down. Right returns to (0,-6). Down leads to (-1,-7) dead end (opens up). Up sightline: (-1,-5) opens up/down, (-1,-4) opens right/down. Moving up.
At (-1,-5). Open: up, down. Down goes back to (-1,-6). Up goes to (-1,-4) which opens right, down. Moving up.
At (-1,-4). Open: right, down. Down goes to (-1,-5). Right sightline: (0,-4) opens right,left; (1,-4) opens up,right,left; (2,-4) opens down,left. Moving right.
At (0,-4). Open: right, left. Left returns to (-1,-4). Right sightline: (1,-4) opens up,right,left; (2,-4) opens down,left. Moving right.
At (1,-4). Open: up, right, left. Up goes to (1,-3) dead end (opens down). Left is back to (0,-4). Right leads to (2,-4) which opens down, left. Moving right.
At (2,-4). Open: down, left. Left returns to (1,-4). Down sightline: (2,-5) opens up/down, (2,-6) opens up/left. Moving down.
At (2,-5). Open: up, down. Down goes to (2,-6) which opens up, left. Continuing down.
At (2,-6). Open: up, left. Up returns to (2,-5). Left leads to (1,-6) which opens up, right. Moving left.
At (1,-6). Open: up, right. Right returns to (2,-6). Up cell (1,-5) opens down, left. Moving up.
At (1,-5). Open: down, left. Left leads to (0,-5) which only opens right (dead end). Down returns to (1,-6). Must backtrack down.

Back at (1,-6). (1,-5) was a dead end. Need to backtrack to (2,-6) -> (2,-5) -> (2,-4) -> (1,-4) -> (0,-4) -> (-1,-4) -> (-1,-5) -> (-1,-6), where all branches might be explored or need to go back further. Right goes to (2,-6).
At (2,-6). Backtracking. Open: up, left. Left was (1,-6) leading to dead end at (0,-5). Up leads to (2,-5) -> (2,-4). Moving up.
At (2,-5). Backtracking up to (2,-4).

At (2,-4). Backtracking left to (1,-4). In (1,-4), up was dead end. Left goes back through (0,-4), (-1,-4), (-1,-5), (-1,-6), (0,-6), (0,-7), etc. Wait, what about (6,1) where we went right to (7,1)? Left from (6,1) had 5 open cells! Moving left.
At (1,-4). Backtracking left towards (0,-4) -> (-1,-4). All explored branches down here were dead ends. Long backtrack required back to (6,1) where west branch remains unexplored.
At (0,-4). Continuing left backtrack to (-1,-4). Target: backtrack all the way to (6,1) to explore the 5-cell corridor to the left.
At (-1,-5). Continuing backtrack down to (-1,-6) -> (0,-6). Down sightline shows (-1,-6) at dist 1, dead end at dist 2. Moving down.
At (-1,-6). Backtracking path: right to (0,-6), then down to (0,-7), then right to (3,-7). Moving right.
At (0,-6). Backtracking to (6,1). Next step is down to (0,-7), then east along y=-7 to (3,-7). Moving down.
At (0,-7). Backtracking to (6,1). Now moving right along y=-7: through (1,-7), (2,-7) to (3,-7).
At (1,-7). Continuing right along y=-7 backtrack path toward (3,-7) -> (3,-6). Next: right.
At (2,-7). Continuing right along y=-7 backtrack to (3,-7), then up to (3,-6).
At (3,-7). Backtracking to (6,1). Right is dead end (4,-7). Must go up to (3,-6), then right along y=-6 to (5,-6) -> (5,-7) -> (7,-7) -> (7,-6) -> (6,-6). Moving up.
At (3,-6). Backtracking to (6,1). Right leads to (4,-6) -> (5,-6). Moving right.
At (4,-6). Backtracking to (6,1). Moving right to (5,-6), then down to (5,-7).
At (5,-6). Backtracking to (6,1). Next step down to (5,-7), then right to (6,-7) -> (7,-7) -> (7,-6) -> (6,-6).
At (5,-7). Backtracking to (6,1). Right sightline shows (6,-7) then (7,-7) opening up,left. Moving right.
At (6,-7). Backtracking to (6,1). Right goes to (7,-7), then up to (7,-6), left to (6,-6), then up to (6,-3). Moving right.
At (7,-7). Backtracking to (6,1). Sightline up shows (7,-6) dist 1, dead end at dist 3. Moving up to (7,-6), then left to (6,-6).
At (7,-6). Backtracking to (6,1). Up is dead end at (7,-4). Left leads to (6,-6), then up the corridor (6,-5..-3) -> (7,-3..-1) -> (7,0..1) -> (6,1). Moving left.
At (6,-6). Backtracking up to (6,1). Sightline shows corridor of 3 cells up: (6,-5), (6,-4), (6,-3). Moving up.
At (6,-5). Backtracking up corridor to (6,-3) -> (7,-3..-1) -> (7,0..1) -> (6,1). Sightline: (6,-4) up dist 1, (6,-3) up dist 2. Moving up.

At (6,-4). Continuing up corridor: next is (6,-3) which opens right, down. Then right to (7,-3) -> up to (7,-2) -> left to (6,-2) -> up to (6,-1) -> right to (7,-1) -> up to (7,1) -> left to (6,1). Moving up.
At (6,-3). Open: right, down. Backtracking to (6,1). Moving right to (7,-3), then up to (7,-2), left to (6,-2), up to (6,-1), right to (7,-1), up to (7,0)->(7,1), then left to (6,1).
At (7,-3). Backtracking to (6,1). Open: up, left. Left returns to (6,-3). Up leads to (7,-2). Moving up.
At (7,-2). Backtracking to (6,1). Left leads to (6,-2), then up to (6,-1), right to (7,-1), up to (7,0)->(7,1), then left to (6,1). Moving left.
At (6,-2). Backtracking to (6,1). Open: up, right. Right returns to (7,-2). Up leads to (6,-1), then right to (7,-1), up to (7,0)->(7,1), then left to (6,1). Moving up.
